invariants.name: coverage_dichotomy
invariants.description: Any valid set of spell positions must either include at least one position in each row, or at least one position in each column. This follows because if some row has no spell, then every column must contain a spell to cover that row's cells, and symmetrically for columns.

invariants.name: unsolvable_condition
invariants.description: It is impossible to purify all cells if and only if there exists a row consisting entirely of evil tiles and a column consisting entirely of evil tiles.
